title: Stream Gatekeeper: tenant residency orchestrator and selective analytics fanout
creator: Leah Park
description: Build a region-aware 'Stream Gatekeeper' service that enforces tenant-level data residency policies during analytics event ingestion and orchestrates selective replication to regional analytics clusters. The Gatekeeper will evaluate per-tenant residency rules and apply a policy DSL to decide fanout targets, quarantine streams, or mark events for redaction before they reach non-authorized regions. This work reduces risk for customers with strict residency requirements while preserving the ability to run global analytics for tenants that allow it.
acceptance_criteria: Gatekeeper accepts ingestion events and returns deterministic routing decisions within 10ms p50 under normal load
Per-tenant residency policy lookup latency < 5ms with caching; policy TTL invalidation supported
Support three enforcement modes: enforce (block/fail), mirror (copy to regional sinks), and tag-only (allow but mark)
Events destined for disallowed regions are quarantined to a secured, access-controlled sink with audit metadata
Automated tests cover policy evaluation, cache expiry, and fallback routing behaviors
Canary rollout plan defined and exercised with synthetic load and two pilot customers
implementation_notes: Architecture: lightweight stateless evaluation layer fronting the event router. Decision path: parse tenant ID -> fetch residency policy from Residency Config Store (read-through cache in memcache/redis) -> apply policy DSL -> produce routing directive (list of target regions, quarantine flag, redaction template). Integrate with existing analytics ingress (Kafka topic per-region) and use header-enriched messages for downstream enforcement. Use a versioned policy schema; Gatekeeper must reject unknown schema versions and fallback to safe-mode (quarantine). Include per-tenant dry-run mode for migration.
rollback_plan: Feature flag controlled rollout. If errors or policy regressions detected: flip feature flag to bypass Gatekeeper and route to legacy global fanout. Retain quarantined messages for replay. Postmortem and hotfix branch to revert policy schema changes. Emergency unquarantine script with audit log will be available to restore event flow for affected tenants.
testing_plan: Unit tests for policy DSL interpreter and schema v1/v2
Integration tests with Residency Config Store mocking and Kafka test clusters (us-east1, eu-west1, ap-south1)
Load test to validate p99 latency SLA at anticipated peak QPS + 50% headroom
Security review and penetration test on quarantine sink access controls
Two-week pilot with internal telemetry and one opt-in customer to validate behavior
